text: the horse raced past the barn fell
rationale: raced heads a reduced relative, so the break closes the subject and blocks the main-verb reading

text: the man returned to his house was arrested
rationale: returned is a participle modifying man, and the break marks where the subject ends

text: the florist sent the flowers was pleased
rationale: sent is passive inside the subject, so the break has to precede the real main verb

text: the defendant examined by the lawyer turned out to be unreliable
rationale: the by-phrase makes the reduced relative unambiguous, and the break closes it

text: the boat floated down the river sank
rationale: floated is a participle, so the break separates the modified subject from sank

text: the student given the answers cheated
rationale: given heads a reduced relative and the break closes the subject before cheated

text: the soldiers marched across the field were exhausted
rationale: marched is a participle here, so the break precedes the finite verb

text: the woman brought the sandwiches left early
rationale: brought modifies woman, and the break keeps left early as the matrix predicate

text: the coach smiled at the player tossed the frisbee
rationale: smiled at the player is a reduced relative on coach, so the break precedes tossed

text: the experienced soldiers warned about the dangers conducted the midnight raid
rationale: warned about the dangers modifies soldiers, and the break closes that long subject

text: while the man hunted the deer ran into the woods
rationale: hunted is intransitive here, so the break stops the deer being taken as its object

text: since jay always jogs a mile seems like a short distance
rationale: jogs closes the subordinate clause, and the break keeps a mile as the matrix subject

text: after the child visited the doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics
rationale: visited ends the subordinate clause, so the break blocks the doctor as its object

text: before the police stopped the driver was getting nervous
rationale: stopped is intransitive here and the break prevents the driver being read as its object

text: as the criminal shot the woman screamed
rationale: shot ends the clause, and the break keeps the woman as subject of screamed

text: whenever the band played the crowd cheered loudly
rationale: played closes the when-clause, and the break stops the crowd being its object

text: though the boy read the letter remained on the table
rationale: read ends the concessive clause, so the break keeps the letter out of its object slot

text: when the dog scratched the vet gave it a sedative
rationale: scratched is intransitive here, and the break prevents the vet being taken as its object

text: the man who came to dinner last night left his umbrella in the hall
rationale: a nine-token subject needs a break before the predicate for the listener to close it

text: the very tall woman standing by the door waved at us
rationale: the participial modifier makes the subject long enough to require a closing break

text: all of the people waiting in the long line outside the theatre got in
rationale: an eleven-token subject cannot be held open across the predicate without a break

text: the report that the committee published last spring was widely criticised
rationale: the relative clause inside the subject forces a break before the matrix verb

text: everything that could possibly go wrong on a trip like this did
rationale: the one-word predicate is only audible if the long subject is closed by a break

text: the small brown dog with the torn left ear belongs to my neighbour
rationale: the postmodifying PP extends the subject past the point where a break is needed

text: several of the older students in the advanced class failed the exam
rationale: the partitive subject runs eight tokens and closes with a break

text: the letter my grandmother wrote during the war arrived last week
rationale: the bare relative clause inside the subject forces a break before arrived

text: she went home and he stayed at the office
rationale: and joins two finite clauses, which is a major break not a minor one

text: i spoke to the manager and the assistant manager was there too
rationale: the second conjunct has its own subject and verb, so the coordination is clausal

text: he ordered soup and salad and a glass of wine
rationale: a three-item list takes a break after each non-final item

text: we invited the old men and women
rationale: old scopes over the whole coordination on the default reading, so no internal break

text: old men and women were evacuated first
rationale: the coordination is a single subject NP and takes no break inside it

text: you can have coffee or tea and a biscuit
rationale: the break groups coffee or tea against a biscuit rather than flattening the three

text: we studied french and german literature
rationale: the two adjectives share literature, so breaking would impose the wrong scope

text: the professor said the students who cheated and their friends would be expelled
rationale: the break closes the coordinated subject of the embedded clause before its predicate

text: my brother the doctor said it was nothing serious
rationale: the doctor is an appositive and is bracketed by breaks on both sides

text: doctor lee the head of cardiology will see you now
rationale: the appositive is parenthetical to the subject and takes breaks on both sides

text: tell me sir what you saw
rationale: sir is a vocative, which is prosodically parenthetical

text: the capital of france paris is a beautiful city
rationale: paris renames the subject and is set off on both sides

text: she said as far as i can tell that the deal is off
rationale: the hedge is a parenthetical inserted between the verb and its complement

text: his oldest friend a man he had known since childhood betrayed him
rationale: the appositive is long enough that both its edges need marking

text: mister president the delegation has arrived
rationale: the vocative is closed off before the message begins

text: that idea however never gained much support
rationale: however is a discourse adverb inserted parenthetically inside the clause

text: in the middle of the night the phone rang
rationale: a six-token fronted PP closes with a break before the subject

text: after a long and difficult negotiation the two sides shook hands
rationale: the fronted PP is closed before the matrix subject begins

text: without any warning at all the lights went out
rationale: the fronted PP is long and takes a closing break

text: having finished her work she went for a walk
rationale: the fronted participial clause is closed before the matrix subject

text: on reading road at ten thirty a live band was playing
rationale: two stacked fronted PPs close together before the subject

text: quite unexpectedly the meeting was cancelled
rationale: the sentence adverb is prosodically separate from the clause it modifies

text: to everyone's surprise the youngest candidate won
rationale: the fronted PP is a stance adverbial and closes with a break

text: if you leave now you will still be late
rationale: the fronted conditional clause closes before the matrix clause

text: the man in the grey coat is my uncle
rationale: written English puts no comma here but the six-token subject still closes with a break

text: what i want to know is why nobody told me
rationale: the pseudo-cleft closes its wh-subject before the copula with no comma in writing

text: the reason he gave for being late was completely absurd
rationale: the subject contains a bare relative and closes before was with no written comma

text: whether we go or stay depends entirely on the weather
rationale: the clausal subject closes before the verb although no comma is written

text: that the experiment failed so completely surprised everyone
rationale: a that-clause subject needs a closing break that punctuation never marks

text: running through the rain without an umbrella is a bad idea
rationale: the gerund subject runs seven tokens and closes before is with no comma

text: john said the professor is a fool
rationale: the break marks the complement clause boundary that a comma would not be written at

text: everyone who knew him well agreed
rationale: the relative clause inside the subject closes before the one-word predicate

text: the number of people who applied this year was much higher than expected
rationale: an eight-token subject closes before the copula with no written comma

text: the question of whether the treaty will be ratified remains open
rationale: the embedded interrogative extends the subject to nine tokens and forces a break
